entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your retaliatory strikes have long-lasting effects.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, worshiper of a chaotic neutral deity.

Benefit(s): If an opponent within line of sight has damaged you within the last minute, you may study that opponent as a standard action. Thereafter, if you hit that opponent with a melee attack, you deal 1 point of bleed damage to that creature in addition to the normal damage dealt by your attack.
